changes: Added a universal self-provisioned diagnostic bridge stage before platform/tool-consent escalation for every current or future managed project.

Extended executable fallback routing with DIAGNOSTIC_BRIDGE_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_TASK and DIAGNOSTIC_BRIDGE_REQUIRES_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION while preserving all existing native diagnostic, access-discovery and Human Gate states.
Required covered diagnostic bridges to execute automatically as bounded least-privilege repository-side probes, with separate bounded tasks when another repository is the correct mutable target.

Restricted self-provisioned diagnostics to sanitized read-only evidence and explicitly prohibited credential exposure, production/runtime data mutation, paid resources, architecture expansion and cross-repository mutation within one task.
Added universal future-project smoke coverage so autonomy does not depend on PINK IPTV, FADEGO, VCAM-PRO or a registry entry.
Aligned Project Leader, Runbook, Recovery Protocol, Supervisor, Recovery Guardian and packaged skill references; package identity becomes Project Leader 0.6.2 and Recovery Guardian 0.5.2.
Preserved task 046 post-merge evidence and exact-bound cleanup authorization for obsolete control/merge-authorization-046 after integration.
